eyebrow: How a request actually passes through
code:
Request
  -> Authentication        (who are you?)
  -> Application Scope     (can your app even reach this table?)
  -> ACL                   (can YOU, this record, this field?)
  -> UI / Data Policy      (is the value itself valid?)
  -> MID Server            (if it must reach on-prem, how does it get there?)
caption: Five independent checks, not one check wearing five names.
